summary: Full backend + frontend testing completed. Found and fixed a critical SecureStore web compatibility bug that blocked entire PIN lock/unlock flow. After fix, all features working correctly.

react_native_issues.issue: expo-secure-store web implementation is an empty object (ExpoSecureStore.web.js = `export default {}`). Calling SecureStore.getItemAsync/setItemAsync throws TypeError on web, causing all PIN operations to fail silently. FIXED by wrapping individual SecureStore calls in try/catch.

critical_code_review_comments: expo-secure-store is not supported on web (ExpoSecureStore.web.js exports empty {}). Any usage of SecureStore on web will throw. Fixed in lock.tsx, setup-pin.tsx, settings.tsx.
The `useNativeDriver: true` in Animated causes warnings on web - cosmetic issue only.
seed_data_creation: PIN 1234 set via /api/pin/setup. 1 test entry created (GitHub URL) for flow testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PIN is 1234 (set in backend DB). On first load, setup-pin screen appears. Enter 1234 twice to setup. Lock screen: enter 1234 to unlock. The SecureStore bug has been fixed - expo-secure-store web implementation throws, so all SecureStore calls are now wrapped in individual try/catch blocks with backend as fallback.

rca_of_issue.bug: PIN unlock fails on web - shows 'Incorrect PIN. Try again.' after entering correct PIN 1234
rca_of_issue.root_cause: expo-secure-store v15.0.8 web implementation (ExpoSecureStore.web.js) exports an empty object `{}`. When the app calls `SecureStore.getItemAsync('vault_pin')`, JavaScript throws TypeError because `getItemAsync` is undefined. The outer try/catch in handleDigit() catches this error and treats it as an incorrect PIN, never reaching the backend API verification call.
rca_of_issue.reproduction: Navigate to /lock, enter 1234 - shows 'Incorrect PIN'. Check Network tab - no API call made to /api/pin/verify.
rca_of_issue.fix: Wrapped each SecureStore.getItemAsync/setItemAsync/deleteItemAsync call in individual try/catch blocks. On error (web), the code skips SecureStore and falls through to backend API verification which works correctly.
